item.title: Stardom president addresses his Tokyo Dome ambitions
item.description: Getting Stardom to the point where it can run the Tokyo Dome is a huge ambition for company president Taro Okada.

item.title: DragonKingKarl: April 4, 1986 Wrestling Observer Newsletter review
item.description: This week on the DragonKingKarl podcast, Karl Stern takes a look back at the April 4, 1986, issue of the Wrestling Observer Newsletter which discusses the lead up to WWF WrestleMania 2.

item.title: UFC Fight Night Adesanya vs Pyfer Predictions
item.description: UFC Fight Night 271 is one of the most emotionally charged Fight Night cards in years. With Israel Adesanya fighting for his legacy and Joe Pyfer hunting his biggest scalp in the octagon yet…

item.title: Marc Mero thinks Sable ‘absolutely’ deserves WWE Hall of Fame induction
item.description: Marc Mero is convinced that Sable definitely deserves a Hall of Fame induction and who should induct him if he is honored too.

item.title: Wardlow in attendance at AEW Revolution
item.description: Former TNT Champion Wardlow was in attendance for this month’s AEW Revolution, but in a backstage capacity.

item.title: WWE announces Sid Vicious for Hall of Fame 2026 class
item.description: The late Sid Vicious (Sid Eudy) is set to be inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame. In a tweet posted by Paul “Triple H” Levesque on Tuesday, it was revealed that Vicious will be part of the 2026 WWE…

item.title: Ronda Rousey vs. Gina Carano Netflix undercard set
item.description: After a fake card made its way around X on Monday, the actual full lineup for this May’s Ronda Rousey vs. Gina Carano MMA event on Netflix has been announced.

item.title: Colt Cabana details his AEW roles
item.description: Colt Cabana is happy with his place in AEW and hopes he never has to find a different job.

item.title: New participant added to WWE NXT gauntlet match
item.description: Charlie Dempsey has been confirmed for tonight’s number one contender’s gauntlet eliminator match on WWE NXT.

item.title: Brock Lesnar grateful to be back in WWE ‘for a short time’
item.description: While appearing on Barstool Sports’ Spittin Chiclets podcast, Brock Lesnar made a comment that is sure to fuel speculation about him retiring from WWE.
